ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud and the individuals and organizations involved
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of Medicaid fraud
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud?
Who is involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money trail will reveal a complex web of fraud schemes and individuals involved. This investigation could lead to further indictments and a better understanding of the scope of Medicaid fraud.
